name: macp_decision_objection
description: Objection: records a formal concern or blocking issue with a proposal. Objections are subject to the policy's objection_handling rules (RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4). Sent as message_type Objection in mode macp.mode.decision.v1.

severity.description: Severity of the objection. Values are lowercase and case-sensitive; any other value, including the empty string, is rejected.
